key_findings: RNA-seq of SCN-CCI rat dorsal horn identified 117 DEGs with Ly6g6e as an upregulated hub gene.
Ly6g6e siRNA reduced pain behaviors, CGRP, NGF, microglial activation and IL-1β, MCP-1, IL-6.
